page.layout: Running head at top centre; page number at top right. Two circular woodcut medallions side by side, with inscriptions around the rims (left: ADAM; right: HEVA and ADAM). Below them one column of running text, two paragraphs. No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword.

main_text.p: DOCET nos sacra scriptura quemadmodum in principio creauerit Deus cœlum & terram: atque vt sexto die formauit hominem (Adam inquam ac Euam) ad imaginem & similitudinem suam: deinde vt Adamo collocato in terrestri paradiso, prohibuerit,cum interminatione mortis, de ligno scientiæ boni & mali edere. At verò à serpente decepta prima mulier,mandatum transgressa,de fructu vetito edit: ac virum suum protoplastum ad edendum illexit:quare statim sub iugum peccati & mortis traditi sunt: atque è paradiso illo semper virente,& sponte omnia ferente eiecti,in terram execratam,in quâ laboribus & sudoribus infinitis vitam transigerent. Adam itaque terram exercuit:Euam vxorem cognouit,quæ peperit illi Cain, deinde Abel, qui à fratre Cain per inuidiam occisus est. Gen. 1. 2. 3. & 4. cap.

ADAM annos natus 130. genuit Seth,à quo patres pietate insignes originem traxere. Seth natus annos 105. genuit Enos: hic cœpit inuocare nomen Domini. Enos,annorum 90.genuit Cainam. Cainam annorum 70. genuit Malaleel. Malaleel annorum 65.genuit Iared. Iared annorum 162. genuit Henoch. Henoch annorum 65. genuit Mathusalam. Porrò Henoch annos natus 365, sublatus est à Deo, nec apparuit. Mathusala annorum 187.genuit Lamech. Lamech annorum 182. genuit Noe. Noe annorum 500. genuit Sem,Cham & Iaphet,100.annis ante diluuium. Erat itaque 600.annorum Noe tempore diluuij. Obiit Adam anno ætatis suæ 930. Vide Gene.cap.5.&7.

page.notes: Two woodcut medallions above the text are engravings, not printed text: left, a bearded man labelled ADAM; right, a figure labelled HEVA · VX · and ADAM. Their inscriptions are described here only. Page number "5" at top right is slightly unclear, marked [?]. Faint show-through from the reverse side is visible in the lower half and was left out. The first word of the page, DOCET, is set in capitals and is not a heading.
